text:
Make the review (introspection) of a failed job see why the producer stopped. Today event_of_job in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs builds the event from the job title, outcome.reason and verification details only. When a job fails with no verification, the outcome reason only points to the producer report. Job 20261017-205554-zaj2's producer said plainly that it stopped because the base lacked a schema that an earlier job was meant to add. Its introspection 20261109-075105-011b still said 'the cause of the empty run is not recorded', blamed job size, and filed the job under an existing failure class. That led to root-cause job 20261109-075120-7zqw, which was rejected because its premise did not fit the job, and it narrowed retry 20261109-075131-e5cg. Fix: when a failed job has a final producer report, put that report's summary, open issues and desires into the event, redacted and bounded in length. Add a test with a no-change producer report and show the stated reason reaches the introspection input. The test must fail without the change.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: The review of a failed job sees only the outcome reason, not the producer's stated reason for stopping, so it guesses a cause and queues fixes for the wrong one
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
